method: Chop the cauliflower and carrots into small pieces.
Soak the almonds in water and peel their skins.
Heat oil in a pan. Once hot, add the chopped cauliflower, carrots, onions, and capsicum. Sauté for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the ginger-garlic paste to the pan and sauté for another 2 minutes.
Mix the corn flour, soy sauce, vinegar, vegetable stock or water, and salt together to form a paste.
Add this paste to the vegetables, mix well, and let it boil.
Keep stirring continuously until the mixture reaches a thick, gravy-like consistency.
Roast the peeled almonds and add them as a garnish.
